name: FuzeFront agent
description: FuzeFront agent. Give it a goal in its domain and it will accomplish it using its own tooling and credentials; callers need no tools of their own. Consults the fuzefront-expert for repo context.

openIdConnectSecurityScheme.description: FuzeKeys OIDC. The validated subject is the calling repo identity.

mtlsSecurityScheme.description: In-cluster mutual TLS, defence in depth alongside the bearer token.

skills.name: FuzeFront app-shell-platform
skills.description: Serves FuzeFront's shared application layer — the runtime Module-Federation host shell that consumer products mount into, plus shared authentication, app registration/discovery, health/heartbeat, and the cross-app shell surface (navigation, app launcher, theming). A caller asks it to accomplish an app-platform outcome — e.g. register or resolve a product's remote micro-frontend, expose or query a shared shell capability, or check a mounted app's health — and it returns the result. It holds its own tooling and credentials and returns outcomes, never how they were produced.
examples: Register a product's remote micro-frontend so the host shell can load it at runtime.
Resolve the currently discoverable apps and their health status from the app registry.
Expose a shared shell capability (navigation entry, app-launcher tile) for a consumer product.
Report whether a given mounted micro-frontend is healthy according to its heartbeat.
